name: formio-ai
description: Form.io MCP server + skill library. Bundles the Form.io MCP server and a skill library covering every endpoint in the Form.io API, plus form JSON schema guidance for generating and editing Form.io forms and resources.

formio_base_url.title: Form.io base URL
formio_base_url.description: Base URL of your Form.io deployment. Leave the default for Form.io SaaS; set it to your host when self-hosting or running Form.io Enterprise. It is the parent of the project URL, it builds the portal-login URL, and it keys the cached token.
